limitations: This is a literal reconstruction of the source hollow-triangle actor connectors. Native use-case syntax renders them as generalization glyphs. The diagram is not treated as proof that a trading venue or firm is a subtype of a regulatory authority: T10–T12 distinguish functional participants and business roles. The source notation versus role semantics remains unresolved (issue-000035). No institutional equivalence is asserted.

All visible connectors in this picture are plain undirected associations. Crossings with bridge humps are not junctions. Equity and Non-Equity connect separately to each of the three transparency-related submissions; no include, extend or generalization is added.

Two distinct Competent Authority actor occurrences are preserved. They represent the two parties to exchange in this picture; a repeated functional role is not deduplicated into one actor. All connectors are undirected as drawn.
